## Summary

## Security and architecture

Explain any effect on authorization, tenant isolation, capability order, model-visible
data, resource handles, artifacts, or public API contracts. Write “No boundary change”
when none apply.

## Validation

- [ ] Package builds passed
- [ ] Typecheck passed
- [ ] Relevant deterministic tests passed

- [ ] Live LLM suite ran when model behavior changed, or the skip reason is documented

- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, `.data`, credentials, or generated artifacts are included

Link relevant issues, ADRs, or pull requests.
